EITS-AWS-002.description: Experimental baseline variant suppressing pairs with an observed successful StartLogging for the exact same account and trail identifier strictly between stop and ingress.
EITS-AWS-002.exact_logic: sql/EITS-AWS-002-restart-aware.sql; all baseline predicates, plus NOT EXISTS a successful matching-trail StartLogging with stop_time < restart_time < ingress_time
EITS-AWS-002.tuning: Candidate only. A restart may be legitimate maintenance or attacker behavior. See preserved before/after evaluation; baseline remains the default.
additional_limitations: Restoration is counterevidence, not proof of benign intent
Exact recorded trail name/ARN equality only; aliases are not reconstructed
A missing restart cannot establish logging stayed disabled
Unknown or equal-time restart ordering is not used to suppress
